critical_code_review_comments: server.py has now grown to 1029 lines (up from 831). Still violates the <700-line guideline. Prompt-studio/templates/approvals code should be split into routers/prompts.py, routers/templates.py, routers/approvals.py.

POST /api/approvals/{id}/comments has no role check — any authenticated user (including team members not assigned to the underlying job's client) can post comments. Consider scoping by user role_key or by client access.

PATCH /api/templates/{id} uses full JobTemplateIn body (all required fields must be resent). Partial updates aren't supported — a client that just wants to bump priority must send name/title_template/etc. Consider Optional[...] fields to allow real PATCH semantics.
POST /api/jobs/from-template computes new_id via count_documents()+1 — race condition if two managers fire simultaneously would produce duplicate OS-###. Use an atomic counter or unique index.
build_active_system_prompt() is called on EVERY AI endpoint hit (DB round-trip per request). Consider a short in-process cache invalidated on PATCH /api/settings/prompts.

Approvals.jsx 'Send reminder' UI shows an amber pill but doesn't optimistically bump reminder_count in local state — it relies on a full refetch; on slow networks, users may double-click and fire two reminders. Debounce or optimistic update recommended.
MyDay.jsx has typo: `gitStandup` (line ~71 handler name) — cosmetic only, works.
Board.jsx uses native HTML5 drag; no visual drop-target highlight on hover — minor UX polish. Also drag events bubble through columns; not tested for keyboard accessibility.
